connector.name: Google Maps MCP Server by cablate
connector.registryDescription: 18 Google Maps tools for AI agents - geocode, search, directions, weather, and more.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-google-map. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cablate account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
env.description: Google Maps API key (get one at https://console.cloud.google.com)

env.name: GOOGLE_MAPS_ENABLED_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated tool names to enable. Omit or * for all 18 tools.
